trend.summary: A genre this month: Claude writing animated, working machines (engines, clock escapements, differentials, mechanisms that move) as code instead of drawing static diagrams, shared widely in October 2026 around an open-source Claude Code skill. funkbox can make that style today: Claude writes the mechanism as a GLSL shader and funkbox renders it as a seamless loop.
trend.demo: Claude wrote gear_train.frag today (three meshing gears with 24, 12 and 8 teeth driving a crank and piston); funkbox rendered it as a 6 s 1080x1920 loop and `funkbox loop check` reported it seamless. The video shows the moving gear train, the real first lines of the shader, and the real check output.

angle: People are asking Claude to build machines that move. funkbox's version: Claude writes a gear train as a GLSL shader (24, 12 and 8 teeth, so the gears turn 1, 2 and 3 times per loop), funkbox renders it and its machine check confirms the last frame flows into the first. No video model, just code.
